component-o.description-s: 3-36V in, 1-16V out, 3A synchronous buck power module (inductor integrated), adjustable output (configured 7.38V nominal; 63.4k/10k gives 7.34V typ)

temperatures_source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: 'TA Operating ambient temperature -40 105'; TJ -40 125 (also 6.1 p5); Tstg -55 150 (6.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings p5)

pins_source-o.table-s: Table 5-1 Pin Functions: 1 RT, 2 EN/SYNC, 3/4/18/19 VIN, 5/6/16/17/28/29 PGND, 7-10/12-15/30 VOUT, 11 SW, 20 CBOOT, 21 RBOOT, 22 VLDOIN, 23 VCC, 24/27 AGND, 25 FB, 26 PG

cfgpins-ao.25c: Feedback divider RFBT VOUT->FB, RFBB FB->AGND. 7.3.2 p15: 'The recommended value of RFBB is 10 kΩ'; VFB 1.0 V typ (6.5 p7). Equation 1 / 8 (p15 / p27) is not legible in the text layer; RFBT = RFBB x (VOUT / 1.0 V - 1) reproduces every Table 7-1 row (p16: 5.0 V -> 40.2k, 7.5 V -> 64.9k). For 7.38 V: 10k x 6.38 = 63.8k; nearest E96 63.4k -> VOUT = 1.0 x (1 + 63.4/10) = 7.34 V typ (-0.5 %). Same R101 63.4k / R102 10k the LM76003 used (1.006 V x 7.34 = 7.384 V there). 64.9k/10.2k (7.36 V) is the closer E96 pair if RFBB may move off 10k.

cfgpins-ao.1c: RT to AGND sets FSW (7.3.5 p18; RT must not be open or grounded, Table 5-1 p4). 10.7 kΩ = 1200 kHz per Table 7-4 (p18), whose VIN = 12 V column allows VOUT 1.5-9.0 V and VIN = 24 V column 2.5-13.0 V at that frequency (IOUT = 3 A). Table 7-1 (p16) recommends 1300 kHz for 7.5 V, but 1300 kHz has no Table 7-4 row and Equation 5 is not legible in the text layer, so the nearest listed row is used. Table 7-4 has no 10.3 V column; see specs-o.vin_headroom-o.

cfgpins-ao.2c: EN/SYNC tied to VIN: 7.3.6 p19 'The simplest way to enable the TPSM63603 is to connect EN/SYNC directly to VIN' (Table 5-1 p4: 'Can be connected to VIN'). This matches the LM76003 board, whose EN (U1.18) sits on VRECT. Figure 8-1 (p25) instead shows a 374k/100k RENT/RENB UVLO divider for VIN(on) 6 V (Equation 6 p19, VEN 1.263 V); not fitted here.

cfgpins-ao.26c: PG open-drain: Table 5-1 p4 'A 10-kΩ to 100-kΩ pullup resistor is required to a suitable pullup voltage. If not used, this pin can be left open or connected to PGND.' 100 kΩ RPG to VOUT as in Figure 8-1 (p25). PG abs max 20 V (p5), recommended 0-16 V (p6); 7.38 V is inside.

cfgpins-ao.22c: VLDOIN tied to VOUT: 8.2.1.2.6 p27 'Connect VLDOIN to VOUT to improve efficiency.' 7.3.11 p22: VLDOIN must be lower than both VIN and 12.5 V (7.38 V < 10.3 V min line). The optional 0.1-1 uF VLDOIN cap (Table 5-1 p4) is not fitted.

cfgpins-ao.21c: RBOOT shorted to CBOOT: 8.2.1.2.6 p27 'Short RBOOT to CBOOT for best efficiency.' 7.3.10 p21: leaving them open keeps the internal 100 Ω (slower SW edge, better EMI).

vin_headroom-o.table_7_4-s: Table 7-4 p18 (IOUT = 3 A), FSW 1200 kHz / RRT 10.7 kΩ: VIN = 12 V -> VOUT 1.5-9.0 V; VIN = 24 V -> 2.5-13.0 V. No column for 10.3 V (columns are 5, 12, 24, 36 V)

timing_source-o.table-s: 6.5 POWER STAGE: 'tOFF_MIN Minimum OFF pulse width VIN = 4 V, IOUT = 1 A, RBOOT shorted to CBOOT 65 85 ns'; tON_MIN 55/70 ns (VOUT 1 V, IOUT 1 A); tON_MAX 9 µs

vin_headroom-o.duty_check_derived-s: derived, not stated: D = 7.38 / 10.3 = 0.717 (ideal, losses ignored). At 1200 kHz T = 833 ns: tON = 597 ns (< tON_MAX 9 µs), tOFF = 236 ns vs tOFF_MIN 85 ns max -> margin. Dmax = 1 - 85/833 = 0.898 -> ideal VOUT ceiling 9.25 V at 10.3 V in. At 20 V in: D = 0.369, tON = 308 ns > tON_MIN 70 ns. Module conduction drops at 2.8 A are not stated, so the real ceiling is lower than 9.25 V; 7.38 V sits below the stated 12 V-column limit (9.0 V) but 10.3 V is outside the table

specs-o.sw_exposure-s: Pin 11 SW is the internal switch node brought out to a pad; the output inductor is inside the module (VOUT pins 'are connected to the internal output inductor', Table 5-1 p4). 'Do not place any external component on this pin or connect to any signal. The amount of copper placed on these pins must be kept to a minimum' (p4). No external inductor strap, so no external switch-node loop

not_stated-o.load_transient at 7.38 V: not stated: p9 row is at 3.3 V; Figures 8-4 / 8-5 (p28, 5 V, 0-3 A and 1.5-3 A at 1 A/µs, COUT 2 x 47 µF) and 8-6 / 8-7 (3.3 V) are scope captures at 200 mV/div with no numeric deviation
not_stated-o.efficiency near 7.38 V / 10.3 V: not stated: Figure 6-7 (p11, VIN 12 V) plots VOUT 1.8-5.0 V only; nearest table point is 12 V out / 24 V in 94.1 % at 1.5 A (p9)
not_stated-o.cout_max_nf: not stated: Table 7-1 gives minimums only; p26 says only that the compensation is optimized for 'a certain range of output capacitance'
not_stated-o.cout_min at 7.38 V: no row; 5.0 V (25 uF) and 7.5 V (20 uF) rows bracket it
not_stated-o.current derating at 7.38 V: not stated: Safe Operating Area curves (Figures 6-10..6-12 at VIN 12 V) cover VOUT 1.8/3.3/5 V only; 6.3 note 2 says IOUT may be derated at high FSW / high TA
not_stated-o.vin_min for 7.38 V at 3 A: not stated: Table 7-4 has no column between 5 V and 12 V; no dropout curve
not_stated-o.vout_ripple_mvpp_typ: not stated for 7.38 V: Figure 6-9 / 6-15 ripple plots are at other VOUT
not_stated-o.rfbt equation text: Equation 1 / 8 (p15 / p27) is not legible in the PDF text layer; the formula used is inferred from Table 7-1 rows

pin_notes-o.23: VCC: 1 uF to PGND, 8.2.1.2.6 p27 / Table 5-1 p4 ('Connect a high-quality 1-μF ceramic capacitor from this pin to PGND'); no external load.
pin_notes-o.3: CIN: 2 x 4.7 uF ceramic minimum (7.3.3 p17, 8.2.1.2.4 p27), 50 V X7R 1206/1210 from Table 7-2 (p17); rating must exceed max VIN (~20 V here).
pin_notes-o.7: COUT: 4 x 22 uF 25 V X7R 1210 (Murata GRM32ER71E226M, Table 7-3 p18). Required: >= 25 uF EFFECTIVE (Table 7-1 p16, 5.0 V row; the 7.5 V row says 20 uF; 7.38 V has no row). The effective value of 4 x 22 uF at 7.38 V DC bias is not in this datasheet; confirm >= 25 uF from the capacitor maker's DC-bias curve.
pin_notes-o.11: SW: 'Do not place any external component on this pin or connect to any signal' (Table 5-1 p4); left open, minimum copper. The inductor is inside the module.
